input[r][c] != 0 or input[6-r][c] != 0 or input[r][6-c] != 0 or input[6-r][6-c] != 0.

Thus row 0 will have 2 for all c!

For c in 1..5 and r in 1..5:
input has only zeros in the interior (cols 1..5, rows 1..5).
All reflections stay in the interior.
So all interior cells remain 0!
